stops.date_confidence: Attested by date through Zylbercweig's contemporary-press bibliography, which lists a letter to the editor in Di tsayt on 14 November 1933 and N. Coordinate is the former Jewish quarter of Vilnius; the city-centre pin is 54.6872, 25.2797.

stops.segment: Three Years in Poland

Benny Mer names Witler among the performers at the Eldorado on Smocza Street, which puts him in Warsaw; a 2007 Jewish Currents piece on his song Varshe states that he never saw the city he wrote about. The Mer article was fetched and read directly; the Jewish Currents piece was not located. Neither claim is dated to a year, and 1934 orders the stop inside the Polish years. Coordinate is an approximate Warsaw placement, not the Smocza Street address.
